pattern_explanation: All four Turkish words were borrowed from French, which is also the source of several English words that look almost identical. Over time the Turkish forms shifted meaning, so the look-alike English words no longer mean the same thing.
false_friend_warning: Watch out: the Turkish word aktuel looks like English 'actual' but means 'current' or 'up to date', and the Turkish word ajanda looks like English 'agenda' but means a diary or planner notebook.
